name: Bounce
source:
A very short kinetic novel in the style of Adagio, you have an energetic art teacher who never seems to quit being helpful. Then comes his retirement after 40 years of teaching, and he makes a speech during your graduation...

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/bounce.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
这是一部非常短的慢板风格的动态小说，你有一位精力充沛的艺术老师，他似乎永远不会放弃提供帮助。然后他在教书40年后退休，并在你们的毕业典礼上发表演讲……

[来自[url=http://renai.us/game/bounce.shtml]仁爱档案馆[/url]]
